html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 29, 2022

On Jun 22, 2022, ecom SaaS ERP Wanliniu (万里牛) (founded 2011; 100k+ merchants) received a strategic round from Laogao Ecom Circle — 4th round — to deepen domestic+foreign trade, inventory fine-ops, and finance-ops integration for global sellers. Matrix: ecom ERP, CBEC ERP, WMS, store POS, B2B supply chain, BI.

— END —
